# Visual polish: before and after

Every page and state captured for the visual polish PR, from main (left) and this branch (right), at half size. Open an image for the full comparison. Captures use the same seeded demo data on both builds; the page background glow is stretched over full-page captures on purpose.

- [Public pages](#public-pages)
- [Dashboard](#dashboard)
- [First-run setup](#first-run-setup)
